messages:
kevin (Sales): Intro: OptiBank wants to validate BYOK with HSM-backed CMKs for a 4-week POC. Ask: can we do this without full Private? They also want daily rotation and SIEM integration.
nina (Solutions Eng): Short: Hosted = no BYOK. Options: Dedicated with customer KMS (CloudHSM/Azure HSM) or Private for on-prem HSM. Dedicated is fastest for POC.
kevin (Sales): Customer insists keys never leave HSM. They asked about proof/attestation.
arun (Security): AWS/Azure HSMs are non-exportable; we can point to vendor attestation (FIPS) and provide integration docs. We cannot export HSM private material.
kevin (Sales): They want to see sample answers for their security questionnaire and a minimal ops runbook snippet. Can we give both?
arun (Security): Draft bullets for questionnaire: - HSM support: Yes, via customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed CMKs (AWS CloudHSM, Azure HSM). - BYOK: Supported on Dedicated/Private; not on Hosted. - Rotation: Custom rotation supported; 24h possible with custom scheduler (increases KMS ops and may affect latency). - Audit logs: Key operations logged by KMS provider (CloudTrail/Monitor). We can correlate Redwood request traces. - Key export/escrow: Key material remains under customer KMS; Redwood does not escrow private keys. - Attestation: We can provide vendor attestation docs and architecture diagram.
nina (Solutions Eng): Minimal POC runbook (ops): 1) Customer creates CMK (CloudHSM-backed) and grants Redwood principal Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/DescribeKey. 2) Provide KMS ARNs and account IDs. 3) Redwood spins a small dedicated pool, configures KMS binding. 4) Run encrypt/decrypt tests, trigger rotation, forward CloudTrail to customer's SIEM. 5) Collect latency and log evidence.
kevin (Sales): Can you paste a tiny config snippet they can show SecOps (no secrets)?
nina (Solutions Eng): Example (redacted):
``` 
kms_provider: aws
cmk_arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-1234
permissions: [kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey,kms:DescribeKey]
rotation: scheduled via CloudWatch -> Lambda or custom job (24h if required)
audit: CloudTrail -> CustomerLogArchive
```
arun (Security): Note: 24h rotations create additional GenerateDataKey and RotateKey events; recommend testing model warm caches. Also require SOW clause clarifying customer responsibility for KMS.
beth (Finance): Pricing: mark Dedicated POC (prorated) + one-time KMS integration fee for onboarding/engineering. I'll send a ballpark after we know pool size.
ci-bot: build/redwood-dedicated/poc-arn-setup started by nina at 1766001500.
kevin (Sales): Great — I'll forward to OptiBank and ask for KMS account IDs, desired rotation window, and whether they require on-prem HSM. Keeping thread here for follow-up.
